Class FhirCodeableConcept

java.lang.Object
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Base
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Element
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Type
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.CodeableConcept
arztis.econnector.rest.model.fhir.FhirCodeableConcept
All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, java.io.Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType
public class FhirCodeableConcept
extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.CodeableConcept
This class is a subclass of CodeableConcept. Therefore it contains reference to terminology or ontology.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 CD, CDA R2 CE and CDA R2 CS into HL7 FHIR CodeableConcept and vice versa.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
